activity.notes: Chandragupta II's accession and terminal regnal years are not known with exact precision. Modern summaries commonly place his Gupta imperial reign around c.375–c.415, while older reference chronology gives approximately 375–413. ATLAS therefore stores both boundaries as approximate.
